question.text: Pandemic risk (e.g., COVID-19) is BEST classified as:

answer.text: Systematic risk that cannot be diversified

explanation.text: The Logic: Pandemic = systemic, affects most sectors globally. Can't be diversified away via holding more companies. The Trap: Some sectors are LESS affected (healthcare, tech); but the aggregate shock is systemic. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B unique; added post-COVID. Manager's Pro-Tip: Sector-specific hedges help during pandemic; broad-market hedges (index puts) are the most general protection.
